text: Feasible as content guidance, with two engine frictions. Page variants are composed independently from pools, so 'But where is X?' on page n only works if page n+1's pool always answers it, which means pairing variants across beats (today the corpus has no cross-page variant links). Second, CalmEnding forbids '?' and 'acaba' only at story/episode ends, so mid-story questions are allowed, but bedtime mode should keep them off the last two pages. Suggest a content-library prototype inside a single beat pair before any engine change.
